definitions.explanation: An event where students or members of a group present what they have learned or prepared, such as a piano recital, a dance show, or a research presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発表会|はっぴょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to my daughter's piano recital.

examples.japanese: {発表会|はっぴょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}している→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I practice every day for the recital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発表会|はっぴょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many reporters gathered at the new-product presentation.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (announcement, presentation) and ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering). Covers everything from children's lesson recitals to corporate product launches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発表会|はっぴょうかい}: a piano recital
- {発表会|はっぴょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a presentation event
- ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧{発表会|はっぴょうかい}: a new-product launch event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リサイタル→リサイタル：27701_risaitaru⟧: recital — used for professional soloists rather than students
- ⟦{演奏会|えんそうかい}→演奏会：18026_ensoukai⟧: concert — a formal musical performance, often by an ensemble
